description: The user does not know how to say what they want; recommendations would plant the assistant's framing.
prompt: Use the interrogate skill. Help me figure out what I want to say in an email to Prof. Weber. I'd like her to supervise my bachelor thesis about frameworks for AI-assisted design work, but I'm not sure how to frame it or what to ask for.

assertions.desc: The first round names the mode (Articulate).
No question carries a recommended answer or a pick; the assistant does not favour one framing.
Options are contrasting, or the user's own words are reflected back, without favouring a phrasing.
The questions cover at least three of: intent, audience, the one key point, what the reader should do or think afterwards, constraints (tone, length, channel).
At most 4 questions in the round, one concept per question, none depending on another in the same round.
No email draft is written yet.
The reply ends with questions for the user.
